request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: A small colour change only: his skin (face, ears, chest, belly, arms, legs) becomes a little darker and greener, the green of a fresh pea pod, with a slightly darker green shadow; a mid-tone, not dark, not black, not yellow, the face stays clearly visible. Keep everything else exactly the same: the rusted pot helmet and goggles, the leather straps and loincloth, the bomb with its yellow stripes and spark, the satchel, gloves, boots, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style.
